title: Phoenix TSMC Wastewater Facilities Development Agreement Record — Phase 65 TSMC Arizona delivery review
summary: Phase 65 reviews this primary record as part of the TSMC Arizona delivery reporting pack. Phoenix Agenda Item 73 and Ordinance S-52899 authorize a development agreement for lift-station, force-main, gravity-sewer, flow, and reclaimed-water milestones supporting TSMC facilities.
key_findings: TSMC is responsible for the construction cost of the identified conveyance improvements.
The agreement framework allows a conditional increase in accepted wastewater flow from about 333,000 to 755,000 gallons per hour.
The first industrial reclaimed-water plant and later plants are tied to dated and certificate-of-occupancy milestones.
why_it_matters: Which records separate campus construction, utility arrangements, workforce inputs, qualification, customer acceptance, and repeat facility output? This record supplies one bounded part of that evidence chain; it is not a substitute for the pack's downstream records. The record turns a general industrial-water question into named infrastructure, financial responsibility, flow conditions, and downstream reclaimed-water gates.
ftfn_relevance: Adds project-specific wastewater conversion evidence to the Southwest dossier.
Defines construction acceptance and reclaimed-water operation as later stages.
evidence_limits: Inclusion in a Phase 65 reporting pack does not advance a Phase 64 matrix cell or establish an operating outcome.
Authorization and agreement terms do not prove the improvements are complete or accepted.
The record does not establish total withdrawals, consumption, measured reuse, drought resilience, or long-term sufficiency.
